newsitem.title: USA: Polk Audio sees modest loss in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Polk Audio sees modest loss in Q4.

text.p: Polk Audio Inc said Monday that it anticipates a "modest" loss for the fourth quarter ended March 30, compared with a profit of $742,000 or $0.44 a share in the year-earlier period.
The company said its sales for the quarter were $13.2 million, down 27 percent compared with a year before.

Polk said it is undergoing an operational restructuring, to be completed within the next 90 days, under which finished product warehousing and all remaining manufacturing and service operations will be consolidated into the company's operations in San Diego. The charge for that is included in the expected loss, said the company.
This will involve the elimination of approximately 16 positions net and is the principal reason, along with the sales decline, for the expected quarterly loss, it said.

The company added that many of its U.S. dealers were experiencing declines in sales and margins and a conservative posture on its part in extending trade credit, additions to reserves for bad debts, and price discounting in certain lines contributed to the quarterly results.
